{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bureau of Volcanoes''' was one of the Bureaus of the [[Algarian Bureaucracy]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], it contested for the jurisdictional rights to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tonder]] against the [[Algarian Bureau of Planetary Colonization]].
